tasks.label: Watch & Deploy samsung-tv-art-uploader (python — restart container)
tasks.command: while true; do inotifywait -qq -e close_write,move_self uploader.py serve.py 2>/dev/null || { sleep 0.5; continue; }; while inotifywait -qq -t 2 -e close_write,move_self uploader.py serve.py 2>/dev/null; do :; done; echo "[deploy:python] change settled, deploying…"; rsync -av --relative -e "ssh -p ${config:samsungTvArtUploader.deploy.sshPort}" uploader.py serve.py ${config:samsungTvArtUploader.deploy.sshHost}:${config:samsungTvArtUploader.deploy.remotePath} && ssh -p ${config:samsungTvArtUploader.deploy.sshPort} ${config:samsungTvArtUploader.deploy.sshHost} "/usr/local/bin/docker restart ${config:samsungTvArtUploader.deploy.container}"; done

tasks.label: Watch & Deploy samsung-tv-art-uploader (assets — no restart)
tasks.command: while true; do inotifywait -qq -e close_write,move_self www/index.html www/favicon.png scripts/fetch_collections.sh scripts/aggregate_csv.py 2>/dev/null || { sleep 0.5; continue; }; while inotifywait -qq -t 2 -e close_write,move_self www/index.html www/favicon.png scripts/fetch_collections.sh scripts/aggregate_csv.py 2>/dev/null; do :; done; echo "[deploy:assets] change settled, syncing…"; rsync -av --relative -e "ssh -p ${config:samsungTvArtUploader.deploy.sshPort}" www/index.html www/favicon.png scripts/fetch_collections.sh scripts/aggregate_csv.py ${config:samsungTvArtUploader.deploy.sshHost}:${config:samsungTvArtUploader.deploy.remotePath}; done

tasks.label: Watch & Deploy samsung-tv-art-card
tasks.command:
echo ha-card/samsung-tv-art-card.js ha-card/README.md | tr ' ' '
' | entr sh -c 'rsync -av ha-card/samsung-tv-art-card.js ha-card/README.md ${config:samsungTvArtUploader.deploy.haCardPath} && rsync -av ha-card/images/ ${config:samsungTvArtUploader.deploy.haCardPath}images/'
